name: Exception Queue
description: A work queue for data-quality exceptions: what is broken, how badly, how long it has been broken, and who owns it.

generation.purpose: Give somebody a prioritised list of exceptions to work through, with the ageing and ownership that decide what to pick up next.
generation.whenToUse: When the page's job is remediation rather than reporting — an exception management workspace, a triage queue, a 'my open items' panel. Choose this over data.table whenever the rows represent work somebody has to do: it orders by severity and age by default, marks items past their ageing threshold, and separates unassigned work from somebody else's.
generation.whenNotToUse: Do not use it as a general grid. If the rows are records rather than work — a security master listing, a file load history — use data.table, which does not impose a triage ordering or an ownership column.

groupBy.description: How the queue is grouped. `severity` is the default because it is the ordering a person working the queue actually wants; `none` gives a flat list.

ageBreachHours.description: Hours after which an exception is marked as breaching. There is no sensible universal default, so the absence of this property means no breach marking rather than a guessed threshold — a queue that invents its own SLA teaches people to ignore the flag.

unassignedFirst.description: Float unassigned exceptions to the top of their group. On by default: unowned work is the work most likely to go unnoticed.

allowBulkSelection.description: Offer row selection and a count, so a page can bind a bulk action. The component never performs the action — it reports the selection and the page decides what it means.

showDetail.description: Render the exception's message under its subject. Off for a compact side panel, on for a full workspace.

exceptionActivated.label: Exception activated
exceptionActivated.description: Emitted when a row is opened. Typically mapped to a drill-down to the record the exception is about.

triageRequested.label: Triage requested
triageRequested.description: Emitted when the user asks to act on a row or on the current selection. The component does not know what triage means — the page binds it to an action.

count.description: How many exceptions the request covers.

selectionChanged.label: Selection changed
selectionChanged.description: Emitted when bulk selection changes, so a page can enable a bulk action.

retryRequested.label: Retry requested
retryRequested.description: Emitted when the user activates Retry in the error state.

xs.note: Rule and assignee move under the subject; the queue becomes a list of cards rather than a row grid, because a triage decision needs severity and age legible on a phone.

accessibility.keyboardContract: The queue is a list. Arrow keys move between rows, Enter activates the focused row, Space toggles its selection when bulk selection is on. Group headers are not focus stops.
accessibility.notes: Severity and breach are carried by text and an icon as well as emphasis colour — a red row is never the only signal. Each row announces its subject, severity, age and assignment state as one label rather than as seven unlabelled cells.
